articles.title: Steph Curry goes full fan mode as Valkyries keep rolling with eighth win in 10 games
articles.summary: Curry was at Chase Center to support the Golden State Valkyries, watching from the stands as Golden State defeated Dallas to win eight of its last 10 games. Tiffany Hayes added 10 points, including a wild buzzer-beating three-pointer to close out the first quarter. With just seconds left, the 14-year veteran dribbled down the floor before launching the shot from the logo, sending Chase Center into a frenzy. Curry immediately joined the celebration, reacting with the crowd before celebrating alongside his Warriors teammate Gary Payton II. The two-time NBA MVP was clearly loving the moment as the arena erupted following Hayes’ incredible shot.

articles.title: The NBA is on alert over the potential move of Dallas Mavericks star Klay Thompson to the Miami Heat, with the Los Angeles Lakers also interested
articles.standfirst: The Heat reportedly have no interest in paying a steep price for the veteran sharpshooter
articles.summary: The Heat reportedly have no interest in paying a steep price for the veteran sharpshooter
articles.body:
Klay Thompson’s future with the Dallas Mavericks has become one of the NBA’s more intriguing offseason storylines, with the Miami Heat reportedly maintaining strong interest while the Los Angeles Lakers could also enter the picture if the veteran guard eventually reaches the open market.

Thompson is entering the final season of the three-year contract he signed with Dallas in 2024. He’s set to earn approximately $17.5 million this season before becoming an unrestricted free agent in 2027.

The Mavericks have explored the trade market for the four-time NBA champion, but a deal hasn’t materialized, leaving his future uncertain.

Miami’s interest in Thompson is well established, but the Heat reportedly don’t want to sacrifice another important young asset to acquire him. Nikola Jovic has emerged as a key name in the speculation, yet Miami appears unwilling to include the 23-year-old forward in a trade.

That stance is understandable after the Heat already surrendered significant young talent and draft resources to acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo. Miami sent Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel’el Ware and Kasparas Jakučionis to the Milwaukee Bucks as part of the blockbuster deal, leaving the franchise with fewer developmental pieces.

Miami’s patience could decide Thompson’s next destination

The Heat’s preferred route appears to be waiting for Thompson to become available rather than paying a substantial price to bring him to South Beach immediately. Miami reportedly believes Thompson could eventually join the team without requiring a trade, although that scenario depends heavily on Dallas changing its current position.

The Mavericks have little incentive to simply buy out Thompson . They’re reportedly focused on finding a trade that would return an asset, whether that’s a draft pick or another useful piece. That has created a stalemate between the two sides.

Thompson would still make plenty of sense for Miami from a basketball perspective. His experience, championship pedigree and ability to shoot from the perimeter could provide valuable spacing around Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo. He’s also comfortable playing without dominating the ball, which could make him an intriguing fit alongside two major offensive focal points.

There are concerns, however. Thompson averaged 11.7 points last season and shot 38.3% from three-point range, a career-low mark. At 36, Miami would have to determine whether his shooting and experience still outweigh the potential decline that comes with age.

The Lakers are another team to monitor. If Thompson reaches free agency, Los Angeles could pursue him without surrendering trade compensation to Dallas. Golden State could also become relevant, particularly given Thompson’s long history with the Warriors and Stephen Curry.

Dallas holds the leverage because Thompson remains under contract. Miami appears content to wait, while the Mavericks continue looking for value. Unless either side changes its position, Thompson’s situation could remain unresolved deep into the offseason.

The NBA will be watching closely, because the outcome could determine whether Thompson begins the next chapter of his career in Miami, Los Angeles or potentially somewhere else.

articles.title: LeBron James accused of faking a phone call to avoid fans at a hotel
articles.standfirst: A resurfaced video is putting LeBron James’ interaction with fans under the spotlight
articles.summary: A resurfaced video is putting LeBron James’ interaction with fans under the spotlight
articles.body:
LeBron James is one of the biggest names in sports, but despite that, his arrival in Philadelphia is among the most anticipated moves in the league , with the arena expected to be packed game after game. ​ ​Since news broke that LeBron James would be arriving in a new city, fans have been eager to see him in new colors . And while he is already an established celebrity in every sense of the word, the attention surrounding his arrival continues to build.

However, as his arrival is being celebrated, a video has resurfaced showing how LeBron may have ignored a group of children he encountered at his hotel, and especially the way he handled the situation.

A quiet hotel encounter is now getting a second look

LeBron had a brief encounter with a family away from the spotlight and without the press around. It was a calm moment, and many viewers believe James had the perfect opportunity to spend some time with them and take a couple of photos.

James was accused of pretending to be on a phone call. Although he did say goodbye to the family before getting into the elevator, some viewers claimed he invented the call so he would not have to stop for photos . Even if the call was real, others argued that he still could have taken a moment with the family. Several people also questioned why he would continue the call into the elevator, where the signal would eventually be lost anyway.

The timing of the resurfaced video has also raised questions

The video has resurfaced at a difficult moment , with fan interaction being especially important as LeBron begins this new chapter. The seats still have to be filled to support what it means to have signed a player of James’ stature , putting even more attention on how he interacts with the public and his new fan base.

In the eyes of some fans, he should do better, even as an established star. Cancellation culture is also at full force today, and neither James nor the franchise would want situations like this to create unnecessary problems or have things start going sideways instead of going as expected.

articles.title: The Lakers travel to Slovenia in total luxury... invited by Doncic
articles.standfirst: The new king of the Angelenos rents a private jet and spares no expense to treat his teammates, who land in his homeland for a five-day training camp
articles.summary: The new king of the Angelenos rents a private jet and spares no expense to treat his teammates, who land in his homeland for a five-day training camp
articles.body:
L uka Doncic plays host . The Slovenian has prepared every last detail of the trip that will take his Lakers teammates to his country starting this Thursday , in a five-day training camp that goes far beyond basketball. Private plane, gifts, gastronomy, fishing, golf... Everything bears the stamp of Los Angeles' new star according to the information revealed by Ramona Shelburne of ESPN .

Doncic has rented a private plane for 14 people and has organized a series of activities designed to bring the revamped Lakers even closer together ahead of the 2026-27 season. He wants to welcome his teammates as true guests of honor . Upon their arrival at the hotel, gift bags filled with typical Slovenian products await them, an initial gesture of welcome that makes it clear who is acting as host.

From Luka's favorite restaurant to fishing on Lake Bled

Luxury will continue around the table. The expedition will visit one of Luka's favorite restaurants , where he will act as a gastronomic guide in his homeland. Then one of the trip's great plans will arrive: a day of fishing on Lake Bled , one of the most spectacular and iconic places in Slovenia.

There will also be time for golf. Austin Reaves has already hyped up the showdown with Doncic, whom he intends to beat on the grass. The goal is for the new Lakers to share experiences, get to know each other better and start building chemistry they will need from the very first day of competition.

Almost the entire squad has signed up for the adventure. It will be five days living together in Ljubljana, from August 20 to 24 , with basketball as the backdrop and a full program of activities to strengthen bonds before the official start of "training camp".

And the trip has a meaning that goes beyond the anecdotal. Until now, LeBron James had largely acted as the Lakers' great host, organizing his own minicamps. With the "King" now out of Los Angeles, Doncic takes up the baton and adapts the tradition in his own way, treating his teammates like royalty .

The new master of the Lakers

Because Luka is no longer simply the Lakers' big star . He is their new leader. And this trip to Slovenia is one of the first visible demonstrations that he is willing to act as such: he opens the doors of his home, takes care of his teammates, and takes charge of a completely revamped locker room.

The Lakers are looking to build a new project around Doncic, and he has decided to start with the most important thing: building team chemistry . Five days of luxury, fishing, golf, and Slovenian cuisine to bring the locker room together. The message is clear: LeBron is gone and Luka is already the new boss of the Lakers .

articles.title: Jeanie Buss and Phil Jackson's 17-year relationship couldn't survive one major NBA decision
articles.standfirst: The Lakers executive and legendary coach spent nearly two decades together
articles.summary: The Lakers executive and legendary coach spent nearly two decades together
articles.body:
J eanie Buss and Phil Jackson once appeared to have one of the strongest relationships in the NBA. Their romance survived championship runs, enormous professional pressure and the unusual dynamic of Jackson working for the franchise owned by Buss' family. But after 17 years together, one major career decision changed the relationship in ways even they apparently did not anticipate.

Buss and Jackson began dating in 1999, the same year Jackson became head coach of the Los Angeles Lakers. What followed was one of the most successful periods in franchise history, with Jackson eventually winning five NBA championships with the Lakers while Buss continued rising through the organization her father, Jerry Buss, had turned into one of basketball's most recognizable franchises. The couple became engaged in 2012.

For years, they managed to keep their personal and professional lives together. But everything became considerably more complicated in March 2014 when Jackson accepted a five-year deal reportedly worth $60 million to become president of the New York Knicks.

The job placed Jackson in New York while Buss remained deeply committed to the Lakers in Los Angeles. Suddenly, a relationship that had largely existed around the same organization had to survive not only thousands of miles of separation, but two NBA franchises with potentially competing interests.

The NBA created another unusual obstacle for Jeanie Buss and Phil Jackson

Distance wasn't their only problem.

Jackson's arrival in New York created an obvious potential conflict of interest for the NBA. Buss held a major leadership position with the Lakers while her fiancé was now running basketball operations for the Knicks.

NBA spokesman Mike Bass confirmed in 2014 that the league had established parameters surrounding their relationship to avoid even the appearance that it could influence the operations of either franchise.

The restrictions reportedly went much further than simply keeping the two executives out of official negotiations.

ESPN later reported that because of the league's conflict-of-interest concerns, Buss and Jackson couldn't discuss matters involving their respective teams. That meant two people whose lives had revolved around basketball for decades suddenly had to carefully separate one of the biggest parts of their professional lives from their private relationship.

It created an extraordinary situation: Buss and Jackson could remain engaged, but the very sport that had brought their lives together had become something they had to keep apart.

Jeanie Buss encouraged Jackson to take the Knicks job

What makes the story even more striking is that Buss initially supported Jackson's return to basketball.

When the Knicks opportunity emerged, Buss publicly acknowledged that Jackson wanted to work again. She described him as too talented a basketball mind to simply remain at home and encouraged his professional ambitions.

At the time, Buss also expressed confidence that the potential conflict could be managed. She had discussed the situation with NBA Commissioner Adam Silver and noted that she wasn't responsible for the Lakers' basketball decisions, which at the time were handled by her brother Jim Buss and general manager Mitch Kupchak.

But there was another revealing comment from Buss that showed just how different their respective relationships with basketball had become.

"The Lakers are my life," she said in 2014.

Jackson's position with New York, she explained, was ultimately a job that would have a beginning and an end. The Lakers, by contrast, were part of her family and something she expected to remain connected to forever.

That difference would become increasingly significant.

The distance became harder than either expected

Jackson and Buss had already experienced periods apart during their relationship, particularly because of the constant travel required of an NBA head coach.

But Los Angeles and New York presented something different.

ESPN reported that the long-distance arrangement placed considerably more strain on the relationship than either Buss or Jackson had anticipated. The conflict-of-interest restrictions only made the separation more complicated because basketball an enormous part of both of their lives couldn't simply become their shared language at the end of the day.

The relationship therefore faced pressure from several directions at once: geographic separation, demanding executive positions, loyalty to two different franchises and NBA rules designed to prevent sensitive information from passing between them.

Eventually, it became too much. After 17 years, Buss and Jackson called off their engagement On December 27.

articles.title: Knicks OG Anunoby lets fans recreate his NBA Finals heroic game winner in Times Square
articles.summary: OG Anunoby just gave Knicks fans the chance to recreate the shot that made him a New York hero.
articles.body:
OG Anunoby just gave Knicks fans the chance to recreate the shot that made him a New York hero.

Back in Game 4 of the NBA Finals, Jalen Brunson missed a three with seconds remaining. Anunoby crashed the basket and tipped it in with 1.2 seconds left, completing a historic 29-point comeback against the Spurs. The Knicks won 107-106 and eventually captured their first championship since 1973.

Two months later, OG brought the moment to Times Square. This time, he played Brunson's role, intentionally missing shots while fans and young players tried to recreate his game-winning tip-in on a special court marking the original play.

From watching the shot to actually trying it themselves, Knicks fans got the chance to relive one of the biggest moments in franchise history with the man who made it happen.

articles.title: Knicks OG Anunoby lets fans recreate his NBA Finals heroic game winner in Times Square
articles.standfirst: Anunoby made the most iconic play of last year's NBA Finals and playoffs
articles.summary: Anunoby made the most iconic play of last year's NBA Finals and playoffs
articles.body:
The New York Knicks are still riding the high of their historic 2026 championship run, capturing their first Larry O'Brien Trophy since 1973. While Finals MVP Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns drove the narrative, the undisputed X-factor of the postseason was OG Anunoby .

Establishing himself as the second-best scorer for the Knicks during their playoff march, Anunoby played an elite brand of two-way basketball—highlighted by his tireless defense guarding every position against the San Antonio Spurs in the NBA Finals and, most famously, his iconic game-winning tip-in during Game 4 that sealed a stunning comeback.

OG Anunoby Takes Over Times Square

Proof of Anunoby's soaring popularity was put on full display in the heart of New York City , where the forward surprised crowds by setting up shop right in Times Square .

In a viral video, Anunoby stood under the bright lights playfully missing three-pointers to give everyday fans the ultimate photo-op and chance to recreate his legendary clutch heroics from the postseason.

The lighthearted activation drew massive crowds of cheering supporters eager to interact with one of the heroes of Broadway. It's a hilarious and refreshing move from a player who spent all year anchoring grueling schemes, logging 33.2 minutes per game , before delivering when the lights shone brightest.

Coming off a stellar championship season where he averaged 16.7 points, 5.2 rebounds, 2.2 assists, and 1.6 steals across 67 appearances while shooting over 38% from beyond the arc , the two-time NBA champion has seen his celebrity skyrocket.

In the Finals alone, he poured in an exceptional 21.2 points and 4.8 rebounds per game , proving he is much more than just a defensive stopper.

As New York prepares to defend its crown, moments like this prove that Anunoby isn't just an elite cornerstone on the court; he has officially cemented his status as a New York sports icon after helping the team win their first title in over 50 years.

articles.title: Shaquille O’Neal breaks his silence on the multi-million-dollar sale of the Lakers, with Jeanie Buss in the spotlight
articles.standfirst: Lakers legend praises the Buss family’s remarkable financial return as ownership drama threatens to reshape the franchise
articles.summary: Lakers legend praises the Buss family’s remarkable financial return as ownership drama threatens to reshape the franchise
articles.body:
S haquille O’Neal has offered his perspective on the extraordinary ownership changes surrounding the Los Angeles Lakers , describing the business side of the franchise’s transition as a “monumental business move” while reflecting on the end of the Buss family’s long association with the team.

O’Neal , who became one of the defining figures in Lakers history during his eight seasons with the franchise, was asked about the record-setting transaction during an ESPN call-in with Treavor Scales .

Rather than focusing on the uncertainty surrounding the Lakers ’ leadership, the three-time champion highlighted the business achievement of the Buss family.

articles.title: LeBron James may have left Lakers in a much better place without him
articles.standfirst: Could The King's departure actually benefit Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers?
articles.summary: Could The King's departure actually benefit Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers?
articles.body:
By most accounts, the Los Angeles Lakers were preparing for life after LeBron James for a little while. Knowing they would have to turn the page sooner than later, the franchise struck a stunning trade for Luka Doncic to be the new face of the organization.

With James heading into his age-42 season as a free agent, the Lakers were in a holding pattern while James made his decision. Once the Lakers knew James wasn't coming back, they got to work on improving the roster . They knew their star player, Doncic, needed help in order to maximize his prime.

They re-signed Austin Reaves , traded for impressive young center Walker Kessler , signed several role players, and acquired first rounder Cameron Carr during the 2026 NBA Draft .

NBA analyst believes Lakers could have higher win total than 76ers this season

Given those moves, plus James' departure which could benefit Doncic, Mat Issa of SB Nation believes the Lakers could actually have a better season than James' Philadelphia 76ers this year.

We have enough of a sample size now to say that James and Luka Doncic were an imperfect fit. According to PBP Stats, the Lakers were better when only one of the two jumbo ball handlers was on the floor than when they shared the court together. At the end of the day, both James and Doncic are better when a team is being molded in their likeness, rather than when they need to placate to others’ wants and needs. ​ ​This iteration of the Lakers isn’t a super team, but they do have a top five-ish player, a borderline All-Star, and a cavalcade of versatile chess pieces to slot around them. Their roster certainly makes a lot more sense than the team that James left them for.

James was far from the Lakers' biggest problem last season, and was efficient as always when he was on the court. But in order for him and his offense to thrive, he needs the ball in his hands. Unfortunately, so does Doncic .

With new pieces around him and the ball set to be in his hands more often, Doncic may have the MVP season Lakers have been teased with in 2026-27.

articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal was taught crucial business lesson by Jeff Bezos that changed his financial trajectory
articles.standfirst: The founder of Amazon once said something to completely stuck with the NBA legend.
articles.summary: The founder of Amazon once said something to completely stuck with the NBA legend.
articles.body:
A lot of professional athletes tend to rest on their laurels once their playing careers come to an end. As is their right, after so many years of putting in such hard work, many use the money they earned throughout their careers and do whatever pleases them in retirement.

Shaquille O'Neal is built different, though - quite literally. The legendary NBA center has remained in the public eye through Hollywood entertainment appearances, as well as his analyst role on NBA broadcasts throughout the season . That should take up enough of O'Neal's time, but Shaq does much more than just that. He's also an avid businessman .

The list of business ventures that Shaq has launched or joined runs very long. He has cast a wide net: From Papa John's to Icy Hot to car washes . Those ventures have helped him build up what is estimated to be a net worth between $400 million and $500 million .

Shaq took Jeff Bezos' advice of investing in companies that could change lives

While it seems that these business ventures come second-nature to Shaq, that hasn't always been the case. In fact, when he first started out, he admitted that he made a lot of bad investments . But a quote from Amazon founder Jeff Bezos changed Shaq's way of thinking, and set him on the right path.

At that point I was investing in ghetto shit and crazy shit and was losing. I was trying to get rich quick. When [Bezos] said 'you invest in things that's going to change people's lives', Ring was one of the first ones I came across. I was like, this is definitely going to change people's lives.

O'Neal has also revealed that after his mindset shift, he believes he quadrupled his net worth . Bezos played a central role in changing Shaq's financial fortunes.

articles.title: "He waited for a reason": The real story behind James Harden’s $97M Cavs contract
articles.standfirst: The former MVP is staying with the Cavaliers after a contract move that helped create room for Peyton Watson
articles.summary: The former MVP is staying with the Cavaliers after a contract move that helped create room for Peyton Watson
articles.body:
The Cleveland Cavaliers spent much of the summer trying to create enough room to improve without breaking apart the core that carried them deep into the postseason. Their biggest piece of business is now complete.

James Harden has agreed to a three-year, $97 million contract with Cleveland, according to ESPN, one day after the Cavaliers reportedly completed a sign-and-trade for Peyton Watson from the Denver Nuggets .

The agreement includes a player option for the 2028-29 season and a 15% trade kicker, giving Harden long-term security while helping Cleveland avoid the kind of second-apron restrictions that could have limited its ability to keep reshaping the roster.

That balance was central to the deal. Harden declined a $42.3 million player option earlier in the offseason, allowing the Cavaliers to lower his immediate cap number and spread more guaranteed money across multiple seasons.

Harden contract gave Cleveland room

Cleveland ’s offseason was shaped by the need to stay competitive while preserving maneuverability.

The Cavaliers had been projected to operate above the second apron, a position that would have made trades and other roster moves more difficult. Harden’s decision to opt out helped create enough flexibility for the front office to continue making changes.

The team also moved Max Strus and Dennis Schroder before adding Watson , then finalized the new contract with Harden . Cleveland acquired the former MVP at the February trade deadline, sending Darius Garland and a 2026 second-round pick to the LA Clippers .

The gamble worked well enough to convince the franchise to keep going.

In 26 regular-season games with the Cavaliers, Harden averaged 20.5 points, 4.8 rebounds and 7.7 assists while shooting 46.6% from the field and 43.5% from 3-point range.

Alongside Donovan Mitchell , he helped Cleveland reach the Eastern Conference Finals before the New York Knicks swept the series and later won the 2026 NBA title.

Harden now in elite financial territory

The contract is also significant beyond Cleveland’s cap sheet. Harden ’s career earnings are now set to pass $500 million, putting him alongside LeBron James, Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry as the only players to reach that mark.

He turns 37 on August 26 and is also set to become just the second player after LeBron to sign a contract worth more than $90 million in guaranteed salary at age 37 or older.

The Cavaliers are clearly betting that there is still enough high-level basketball left.

Harden may no longer be the overwhelming scorer who defined his years with the Houston Rockets , but Cleveland values his playmaking, shooting and ability to share control of the offense with Mitchell .

His new contract also keeps the franchise from having to choose between maintaining a contender and preserving flexibility. After adding Watson and securing Harden , Cleveland’s offseason direction is no longer difficult to read.

The Cavaliers believe their championship window is still open, and they are keeping Harden firmly inside it.

articles.standfirst: "The Beard" will remain in Cleveland for three more seasons, the third as a player option
articles.summary: "The Beard" will remain in Cleveland for three more seasons, the third as a player option
articles.body:
He was one of the most attractive free agents on the market, although no one expected him to change scenery. And he won’t. James Harden , after declining his player option in June and $42 million, reached an agreement with the Cavs to remain with the team for the next three seasons on a $97 million contract . The third season will be a player option.

The deal will make " The Beard " the fourth player to have earned the most money in NBA history. In fact, he will be the fourth to surpass the $500 million earned mark over the course of a career (511 for "The Beard"), after LeBron James, Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry.

In a few days, on August 26, Harden will turn 37 and could extend his career until 40 if he fulfills his entire contract with Cleveland. He is the second player in history to sign a contract guaranteed for more than 90 million at age 37 . The other, of course, was LeBron . In addition, "The Beard," who is beginning his 18th season in the NBA, could round out his career with 20 active seasons.

Harden , instead of preferring the 42 million from his final year, chose to work with the Cavs on two scenarios, a two-year contract and a three-year one, the latter as a player option, which is the one that has prevailed. In addition, the waiting period has allowed the Cavs to work on the rest of their roster. The chosen option allows the Cavs to pay Harden over three years instead of two and thus be able to stay below the first and second aprons in the salary cap.

If "The Beard" lives up to his track record, the Cavs will not finish with a losing record in the regular season ; Harden has never done so with any of the teams he has played for. But that is an easy prediction to make for a team that aspires to everything in the East.

articles.title: Lakers insider floats shocking Nikola Jokic-Luka Doncic superteam possibility
articles.standfirst: Lakers could have their eyes on Nikola Jokic if Denver's championship plans fall apart
articles.summary: Lakers could have their eyes on Nikola Jokic if Denver's championship plans fall apart
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Lakers could have their sights on an incredible future pairing of Luka Doncic and Nikola Jokic.

A potential Lakers pursuit of the Denver Nuggets superstar remains highly speculative, but recent developments have given the idea fresh momentum.

Denver's decision to send Peyton Watson to the Cleveland Cavaliers in a sign-and-trade has raised eyebrows around the NBA.

Watson , who was viewed as one of the Nuggets' most promising young players, agreed to a four-year, $88 million contract with Cleveland. Denver received an unprotected 2031 first-round pick and a 2032 second-round selection in the deal.

For a Nuggets team built around a 31-year-old three-time MVP, moving a young player with significant upside naturally raises questions.

Jokic remains at the heart of Denver's championship hopes and continues to perform at an extraordinary level. Last season, he averaged 27.7 points, 12.9 rebounds and 10.7 assists while earning another All-NBA First Team selection.

Those circumstances have apparently caught the attention of Lakers insider Anthony Irwin. He suggested that once Los Angeles' ownership situation is settled, the organization could become "dead-set" on Denver and Jokic . That doesn't mean a trade is coming, but it suggests the Lakers could be monitoring the situation closely.

“All I'll say is if/when the Lakers get their ownership situation figured out, a lot of the organization's eyes are going to be dead-set on Denver,” Irwin wrote on X.

Jokic-Doncic pairing could redefine Lakers' future

The possibility becomes even more intriguing because Jokic and Doncic have a well-known friendship. The two superstars have shared plenty of memorable moments, and their relationship has been one of the NBA's most entertaining off-court connections.

Their chemistry could make the prospect of playing together particularly appealing.

Los Angeles has already made Doncic the centerpiece of its future. The Lakers signed him to a three-year, $165 million extension in 2025, showing that the franchise is committed to building a championship contender around him. Doncic has also made it clear that he doesn't want to spend years waiting for the right roster to come together.

Jokic's situation is very different. The Nuggets superstar has repeatedly expressed his desire to remain in Denver and has indicated that he'd like to spend his career with the franchise.

He's also expected to have an opportunity to negotiate a massive extension next summer, which would give Denver another chance to lock its cornerstone into the future.

Still, circumstances can change quickly in the NBA. If Denver struggles again and can't surround Jokic with enough quality talent, speculation about his future could become considerably louder. The Nuggets' decision to move Watson could become more significant if their roster fails to meet expectations.

That would create an opportunity worth exploring for the Lakers. Pairing Jokic with Doncic would give Los Angeles two of the game's most gifted offensive engines.

Both can score at all three levels, manipulate defenses and create high-quality opportunities for teammates. Adding Austin Reaves to that foundation would give the Lakers another versatile creator and potentially form a devastating Big Three.

For now, though, a Jokic -to-Los Angeles move is a dream scenario rather than an imminent possibility. Jokic remains a Nugget, and Denver controls the situation. But if the franchise's championship window begins to close, the Lakers could be waiting in the wings.

articles.title: How much did Luka Doncic spend on inviting his Los Angeles Lakers teammates to Slovenia?
articles.standfirst: Doncic is using his home country to bring the Lakers closer together
articles.summary: Doncic is using his home country to bring the Lakers closer together
articles.body:
Luka Doncic appears to have spared little expense in bringing his Los Angeles Lakers teammates to Slovenia, with the private jet alone potentially costing more than $500,000 for the round trip.

The Lakers traveled from Los Angeles to Ljubljana aboard a Bombardier Global 8000, one of the most luxurious business jets available. Slovenian reports stated that the aircraft carried 14 Lakers players and took roughly 11 to 13 hours to make the journey.

articles.title: Timberwolves fetch $4.5 billion valuation after Lakers sale: What Marc Stad’s takeover means for A-Rod
articles.standfirst: A-Rod isn’t going anywhere as Marc Stad takes control of the Timberwolves and Lynx
articles.summary: A-Rod isn’t going anywhere as Marc Stad takes control of the Timberwolves and Lynx
articles.body:
The Minnesota Timberwolves are changing hands again, and the latest transaction could significantly reshape Alex Rodriguez’s role with the franchise.

Businessman Marc Stad is set to become the Timberwolves’ controlling owner and largest shareholder after agreeing to purchase most of Marc Lore’s stake in a deal valuing the NBA team and WNBA’s Minnesota Lynx at $4.5 billion.

The transaction still requires approval from the NBA’s Board of Governors, which is expected to consider it at its September meetings.

The announcement comes shortly after the Los Angeles Lakers agreed to a record $12.5 billion sale to Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger . That valuation is almost three times the Timberwolves’ latest price, highlighting the enormous financial gap between the NBA’s most valuable brands and smaller-market franchises.

Stad’s arrival doesn’t mean an exit for Rodriguez . Instead, the former MLB star plans to increase his equity stake while taking on an expanded leadership role.

He’ll remain alternate governor of the Timberwolves and governor of the Lynx, while Stad’s wife, Elisa Stad , is expected to become the Timberwolves’ governor.

What Stad’s takeover means for Rodriguez

The new arrangement appears designed to preserve continuity rather than trigger another wholesale change. Lore will remain a minority investor after reducing his ownership to concentrate on his Wonder Group business and its planned IPO push.

Rodriguez , meanwhile, will have a larger financial commitment and is expected to spend more time around the teams.

That’s a notable development because Rodriguez and Lore only completed their purchase of the Timberwolves last year, following a 2021 agreement that valued the franchise at $1.5 billion. The new $4.5 billion valuation represents a remarkable increase in just a few years and ranks among the largest franchise transactions in NBA history.

Stad isn’t an outsider, either. The founder and managing partner of Dragoneer Investment Group was already a significant minority investor in the Timberwolves and Lynx.

He’s also previously invested in the NHL’s Seattle Kraken. His familiarity with the organization should make the transition less disruptive, with Minnesota’s existing basketball leadership expected to remain in place.

That continuity could be particularly important given the progress made under Rodriguez and Lore . The Timberwolves have reached the playoffs in each of the five seasons since the duo first bought into the franchise, advancing to the Western Conference finals in 2024 and 2025.

Before their arrival, Minnesota had won just two playoff series in franchise history.

The team is now built around Anthony Edwards and recently made an aggressive move for LaMelo Ball , creating a potentially explosive backcourt. Ownership has also shown a willingness to spend into the luxury tax while pursuing championship ambitions.

The Lynx are another major asset. Under longtime coach Cheryl Reeve, Minnesota has won four WNBA championships and remains one of the league’s strongest teams.

This deal appears to mean that Rodriguez will have more of a say in matters. His ownership stake is increasing, his responsibilities are expanding, and he’ll remain closely involved as Minnesota enters another important chapter.

The biggest change is that Stad will now have final control, but A-Rod isn’t being pushed aside.

articles.title: Klay Thompson sends a message to the Warriors and Mavericks with superb shooting
articles.standfirst: Few players in basketball can get a shot off as quickly or efficiently as him
articles.summary: Few players in basketball can get a shot off as quickly or efficiently as him
articles.body:
If there was any doubt that Klay Thompson can still fill up a basket, his latest offseason workout should put those concerns to rest. The four-time NBA champion recently showcased his trademark shooting stroke during a workout with player development and analytics expert Justin Zormelo.

What caught the attention of basketball fans was not just Thompson's smooth mechanics or lightning-fast release, it was the fact that he seemingly didn't miss. Shot after shot splashed through the net as Thompson demonstrated the same elite shooting ability that made him one of the most feared perimeter scorers of his generation.

The workout served as a reminder that even at this stage of his career, few players in basketball can get a shot off as quickly or efficiently as the former Golden State Warriors star. For teams that decided not to keep him, the footage may have been difficult to ignore.

Thompson can define games with his shooting

After reportedly agreeing to part ways with the Dallas Mavericks, Thompson appears set to begin a new chapter of his career. Reports have indicated that the veteran guard is expected to sign a two-year contract worth approximately $13 million with the Miami Heat, including a player option for the second season.

If Thompson carries his offseason form into meaningful games, both Dallas and Golden State could find themselves wondering whether they should have made a stronger effort to retain one of the greatest shooters in NBA history. The Warriors know better than anyone what Thompson can do when he gets hot.

During his remarkable run in Golden State, Thompson helped transform the franchise into a dynasty alongside Stephen Curry and Draymond Green. He won four NBA championships , made five All-Star teams , and authored some of the most memorable shooting performances the league has ever seen. His 37-point quarter against Sacramento and his 14 three-pointers in a game against Chicago remain legendary achievements.

His gravity creates opportunities for everyone else

While age and injuries have naturally changed parts of his game, Thompson's shooting touch has never disappeared. That is why the latest workout generated so much attention. The quick release remains intact. The confidence remains intact. Most importantly, the ball continues to find the bottom of the net with remarkable consistency.

Dallas originally brought Thompson in to provide floor spacing around its stars and add championship experience to the locker room. Even when his scoring numbers fluctuated, opposing defenses still had to respect him every time he crossed half court. That gravity creates opportunities for everyone else on the floor.

Now, if Thompson lands in Miami and rediscovers the rhythm that made him one of basketball's premier shooters, the Heat could end up with one of the offseason's biggest bargains. A two-year deal worth around $13 million would represent relatively low financial risk for a player who still possesses an elite NBA skill.

Shooting remains the most valuable commodity in today's game, and Thompson has built an entire Hall of Fame-caliber career on his ability to stretch defenses beyond their breaking point.

articles.title: LeBron James' agent reveals what ultimately convinced 'The King' to join the Sixers
articles.standfirst: Rich Paul explains why the Sixers became the perfect destination for the 41-year-old star
articles.summary: Rich Paul explains why the Sixers became the perfect destination for the 41-year-old star
articles.body:
When LeBron James decided to continue his NBA career, few expected the next stop in his historic journey to be Philadelphia.

After eight seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers , the 41-year-old superstar chose the Philadelphia 76ers for his 24th season, prioritizing another championship opportunity over the comfort of staying in Los Angeles.

The move surprised many around the league, especially given the circumstances. James reportedly accepted a significant pay cut to join Philadelphia, leaving behind a franchise where he won a championship and became one of the biggest figures in team history.

Now, longtime agent Rich Paul has revealed what helped make the 76ers an attractive destination, pointing to a factor that went beyond contracts and roster construction: the way Philadelphia embraces its athletes.

“I think it was just about appreciation for him, you know? I think Philly is someone, it’s a place that appreciates their athletes, and you know, whenever he played here, even when he was on a different team, they always showed their appreciation for him,” Paul told reporter Jason Dumas.

Paul has strong personal connections to Philadelphia, dating back to his relationship with Mitchell & Ness , the city-based sports apparel brand. However, he made it clear that his history with the area didn't influence LeBron James ’ decision.

“And you know, it was his choice, and I wasn’t, you know, pushing him one way or the other,” Paul added.

Instead, Paul explained that the overall situation in Philadelphia helped convince James that the move made sense. The presence of Joel Embiid , Tyrese Maxey , and the direction of the organization all played important roles.

“Obviously, Tyrese being here, Joel, some of the moves being made, you know, how the organization is positioned, whenever he’s making a decision, you gotta look at everything from the top down,” Paul said.

One more title chase over retirement

The decision came after LeBron James seriously considered whether his career was coming to an end. After another long NBA season, retirement became a possibility before the four-time champion decided he still had more to give.

James made it clear his motivation wasn't financial. He wanted another chance to compete at the highest level.

“I believe I can help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team, and I am so excited to energize a new fan base and start this incredible journey one last time,” James said.

The opportunity wasn't always obvious. Paul previously admitted that Philadelphia wasn't viewed as a realistic landing spot before talks developed.

“We never heard from the Sixers because the Sixers never really thought there was even a chance,” Paul said. “No, we never even thought there was a chance.”

LeBron can solve Sixers’ biggest challenge

The next challenge will be making Philadelphia’s collection of stars work. The 76ers now feature James, Embiid, Maxey, Jaylen Brown, and V.J. Edgecombe , creating one of the most talented groups in the NBA.

Former Lakers star Magic Johnson believes the answer lies in LeBron James ’ ability to bring teammates together.

“Well, it’s going to be easy when you’re a playmaker, you know. So he gets everybody involved in the game. He gets people easy buckets and shots,” Johnson said.

“And so when you think about Maxey and Embiid, all those guys, now Jaylen Brown. One thing that he knows how to do is also bring everybody together.”

That ability has been one of the defining traits of LeBron James ’ career. From Dwyane Wade and Chris Bosh in Miami to Anthony Davis in Los Angeles, he has repeatedly adapted his game alongside elite talent.

Philadelphia is asking him to do it again. According to Rich Paul , the city’s respect for its athletes may be the foundation that helps this unexpected partnership succeed.

articles.title: Vanessa Bryant hasn't forgotten Kobe as she posts a heartbreaking photo on his 48th birthday
articles.standfirst: Magic Johnson, Dwyane Wade and fans celebrate the life of a basketball icon gone too soon
articles.summary: Magic Johnson, Dwyane Wade and fans celebrate the life of a basketball icon gone too soon
articles.body:
Kobe Bryant ’s impact on basketball has never faded, and on what would have been his 48th birthday, his family and the NBA community came together to remember one of the sport’s greatest icons.

Vanessa Bryant honored her late husband on Sunday, August 23, sharing a heartfelt tribute on social media alongside a personal photo of the couple.

The message reflected the enduring love and admiration she continues to hold for the Lakers legend more than six years after his death.

“Happy birthday, baby. I love you so much. 8/23,” Vanessa wrote. Bryant , born on August 23, 1978, in Philadelphia, became one of the most influential players in NBA history during a remarkable 20-year career with the Los Angeles Lakers .

He won five championships, earned two NBA Finals MVP awards and became synonymous with his relentless approach to the game known as the “Mamba Mentality.”

Kobe and his 13-year-old daughter, Gianna , were among nine people who died in a helicopter crash in Calabasas, California, in January 2020. The tragedy devastated the basketball world and continues to be remembered by fans, players and organizations across the sport.

NBA continues to celebrate Kobe Bryant’s influence

The anniversary of Bryant ’s birthday brought an outpouring of messages from those who admired his career and the impact he had beyond the court.

Magic Johnson was among the NBA figures who paid tribute, sharing a message honoring Bryant ’s lasting influence.

“I want to wish a happy heavenly birthday to Kobe Bryant!” Johnson posted.

The Lakers also celebrated their franchise legend with a tribute that highlighted his place in team history. “Icon. Legend. Laker. Happy Birthday, Kobe,” the organization shared.

Fans filled Vanessa Bryant ’s post with messages of support, remembering Kobe not only for his achievements, but also for the inspiration he provided to generations of athletes.

Former NBA star Dwyane Wade has previously spoken about the qualities that made Bryant different from other players. The two shared the court while representing Team USA at the Olympics, giving Wade a close look at Bryant ’s mindset and competitive drive.

“Oh he different… I saw things in him that I was like I have those things but I also saw a difference. This is why he’s as great as he is,” Wade said. “He was my favorite in the Olympics, man.

"I was like a magnet anytime I got a chance to be around Kobe. Because I’m just soaking it up. And he’s one of my favorite players.”

Kobe legacy continues to inspire

While Bryant ’s playing career ended in 2016, his influence has continued to shape basketball. Players around the world still reference his dedication, preparation and pursuit of excellence as examples of what it takes to succeed.

The “Mamba Mentality” has become a phrase associated with determination and resilience, extending far beyond basketball and becoming part of Bryant ’s lasting legacy.

As Vanessa Bryant and their family continue to celebrate his life, Kobe remains one of the most respected figures in sports history. His achievements on the court made him a legend, but his influence on those who followed his journey has ensured his memory continues to live on.

articles.title: Ex NBA star Delonte West receives a life changing miracle to get his life back
articles.standfirst: A new opportunity could give the former NBA guard a fresh start
articles.summary: A new opportunity could give the former NBA guard a fresh start
articles.body:
Life can change in an instant, and one day you can be at the top while the next can take you somewhere completely different. Former NBA player Delonte West has faced a long, public battle with bipolar disorder, substance abuse, and homelessness following his retirement from basketball in 2015.

articles.title: Luka Doncic’s shocking transformation: Lakers star looks fitter than ever this offseason
articles.standfirst: Luka Doncic shocked the NBA world with his latest transformation.
articles.summary: Luka Doncic shocked the NBA world with his latest transformation.
articles.body:
In February 2025, during his final days with the Dallas Mavericks before his shocking trade to the Los Angeles Lakers , Luka Doncic was criticized for his weight and conditioning. The Slovenian turned those comments into motivation and arrived in Los Angeles with a completely renewed physique, surprising fans and analysts alike.

Big changes for Luka Doncic

Months later, the six-time NBA All-Star is once again generating headlines because of his physical transformation. During the offseason, Doncic appears to have taken another step forward and looks noticeably slimmer, a change that many on social media are viewing as a new version of the Lakers superstar.

Content creator Niko shared an image of the player and highlighted that Doncic currently appears to be one of the slimmest players on the Lakers roster.

“Luka looks like he is back to his early Mavs weight, looks good,” he wrote.

The image and video were captured during the Lakers minicamp in Slovenia, an experience organized by Doncic, who hosted his teammates in his home country during a four-day trip.

During the visit, the Slovenian star took the opportunity to build team chemistry: he brought the group kayaking, visited the basketball court where his journey began and even participated in a bicycle race through the streets of Ljubljana .

Doncic had previously explained the changes he made to improve his physique. The star revealed that he lost around 38 pounds (17 kilograms) after changing his diet, cutting out sugar, reducing gluten intake and increasing his protein consumption.

“Obviously, be the best that I can be, take care of myself,” he said at the time. “This year, with my team, I think we did a huge step. But this is just the start, you know. I need to keep going. Can’t stop.”

With the 2026-27 NBA season just around the corner, Lakers fans are hoping this new version of Luka Doncic translates into more explosiveness, improved endurance and, above all, a stronger push toward the championship they desperately want.

articles.title: A Jordan jersey could be the most valuable sports item in history: $100 million!
articles.standfirst: On September 15, the garment the legend wore in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals, when he won his sixth ring with the Bulls before retiring, will be auctioned.
articles.summary: On September 15, the garment the legend wore in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals, when he won his sixth ring with the Bulls before retiring, will be auctioned.
articles.body:
T he jersey Michael Jordan wore in Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals could become the most valuable item in sports history. It will be auctioned on September 15 and could fetch $100 million!

It's the white jersey the legend wore in the third game of the series against the Jazz. In addition to being one of his last games with the Bulls, during his "Last Dance" season , he wore it in a matchup that ended with a score of 96-54 .

To make the garment even more unique, those 42 points are the largest margin in an NBA Finals game . On that June 7, given the wide gap on the scoreboard, Jordan played only 32 minutes , his lowest total in those playoffs, and scored 24 points .

' The current owner of the jersey is sports investor and actor Rob Gough , who came into possession of it years ago through various intermediaries without ever getting to know who really owned it. He has other historic pieces worn by legends such as Kobe Bryant, Wilt Chamberlain, Tom Brady and Wayne Gretzky . "It’s about acquiring pieces that sit at the intersection of the greatest athlete, the greatest stage, and a defining moment," he says.'

Now he is putting it up for auction because he believes it was not being appreciated as it deserves. "I have many wonderful works of art. And when people come to the house, they skip over them to go straight to the jersey . That was when I realized that this is the new modern art" , says Gough.

I have many wonderful works of art. And when people come to the house, they skip past them to go straight to the jersey

Another Jordan jersey, used in the first game of those 1998 NBA Finals, was sold for $10.1 million in 2022 . However, the Bulls lost that game 88-85 after overtime. "I don't buy pieces from games in which a player loses because one thinks, 'That jersey on the wall, remember when Michael Jordan lost that game?' You just don't say that," he concludes.

Gough had already made a name for himself in the collectibles industry after buying a rare 1952 baseball card of star Mickey Mantle for $5.2 million in 2021.

articles.title: Klay Thompson's father isn't thrilled about his son's team switch and leaves the door open for the Lakers
articles.standfirst: Mychal Thompson backs his son's move to Miami but makes it clear he would have preferred to see him in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Mychal Thompson backs his son's move to Miami but makes it clear he would have preferred to see him in Los Angeles
articles.body:
K lay Thompson 's move to the Miami Heat has received the backing of his father, Mychal Thompson , but the former NBA player has also made no secret of the fact that he would have preferred to see his son wearing the Los Angeles Lakers jersey.

Thompson joined the Heat after spending the first 13 seasons of his NBA career with the Golden State Warriors .

The move represented one of the biggest changes of the veteran guard's career after he helped turn Golden State into a championship powerhouse alongside Stephen Curry and Draymond Green .

For Mychal , however, there is apparently still one destination that would have made the move even better.

"Love it… Great teammates, excellent coaching. Riley’s there to advise him like Jerry West was in Golden State… Only thing that would've been better was if he was with my Lakers," Mychal Thompson wrote on X.

The comment offered an enthusiastic endorsement of Miami while simultaneously keeping the Lakers conversation alive.

Mychal spent the majority of his own playing career with Los Angeles and won two championships with the franchise, making his connection to the organization particularly strong.

Klay's arrival in Miami also gives the veteran an opportunity to begin a new chapter under one of the most respected executives in basketball, Pat Riley.

The Heat president has already made it clear that he believes Thompson can contribute far beyond his reputation as one of the game's greatest shooters.

"Klay is one of the most iconic players to ever suit up in the NBA," Miami Heat president Pat Riley said.

"A four-time battle-tested world champion who will fit perfectly into his role as an all-around player at both ends of the court. We all talk about his shooting skill, but there is so much more he brings to the game. We are blessed that Klay chose the Heat in our quest to challenge for championships."

Why the Lakers connection remains intriguing

The Lakers angle is particularly interesting because of the history surrounding Klay's family. Mychal's affection for Los Angeles is well established, and Klay has long been linked with the Lakers in speculation because of his Southern California roots.

That does not mean there is an immediate indication that Thompson is planning another move. His commitment to Miami is the important development, and Riley clearly views him as an experienced piece who can help the franchise compete.

The Heat are acquiring far more than a player capable of stretching defenses from three-point range.

Thompson brings championship experience, an extensive understanding of team basketball and the ability to play alongside other stars without needing to dominate the ball.

His career in Golden State also demonstrated his value as a perimeter defender when healthy. Although injuries have changed his role and athletic profile, his shooting remains a significant weapon that can alter how opposing defenses approach Miami.

For Thompson himself, the move offers a chance to escape the familiarity of Golden State and establish himself in a different system.

The Heat's culture and Riley's championship pedigree provide an obvious fit for a player who has spent much of his career competing at the highest level.

Mychal's comments therefore appear to be more affectionate than critical. He has endorsed the decision and praised the people surrounding his son, while joking that his ideal scenario would have involved Klay joining the Lakers .

For now, that possibility remains exactly that, a possibility rather than a developing move. Thompson's immediate future is in Miami, where the Heat will expect the veteran sharpshooter to provide experience, scoring and leadership.

Still, his father's words ensure that Lakers fans have another reason to keep the connection in the back of their minds.

articles.title: LeBron James looks toward life after basketball with a major PGA Tour partnership in Ohio
articles.standfirst: LeBron's passion for golf has grown so much that he launched his own YouTube channel devoted to the sport
articles.summary: LeBron's passion for golf has grown so much that he launched his own YouTube channel devoted to the sport
articles.body:
It is hardly difficult to imagine that once his current two-year contract with Philadelphia concludes, LeBron James will officially step away from the hardwood, hanging up his sneakers after an astonishing 25 seasons in the NBA.

We will undoubtedly never witness anything quite like it again; maintaining a top-tier superstar level for a quarter of a century almost sounds superhuman.

The primary motivation driving LeBron’s calculated move to Philadelphia was the pursuit of a fifth championship ring , prompting him to sign with a powerhouse contender for a bargain rate of under $8 million total over two years since financial gain is no longer a driving factor.

Now at 41 years old , LeBron's summer routines look vastly different than they did a decade ago. Outside of his family, he has poured immense passion into golf , a new hobby that inspired him to launch a dedicated YouTube channel earlier this month, where his debut video featured an emotional reunion of the 2016 Cleveland Cavaliers squad that famously shattered the city's 52-year championship drought across major professional sports.

LeBron James Partners With PGA Tour to Launch Akron Golf Event in 2027

LeBron's burgeoning passion for the links has officially evolved into a major philanthropic venture, as he and the PGA Tour announced a partnership to bring professional golf back to his hometown of Akron , Ohio, beginning in 2027 .

The inaugural LeBron James Family Foundation Invitational is scheduled for July 6–7 at the legendary South Course at Firestone Country Club , featuring a unique blend of amateurs and rising professionals from the tour's Pathway to Progression Pro-Bound Five program .

This initiative creates direct pathways for the top five performers in the final Advocates Professional Golf Association (APGA) Collegiate Ranking each season to secure membership on the APGA Tour , aligning seamlessly with the mission of James's I Promise program , which empowers students and families throughout Akron with vital educational resources and mentorship.

Beyond competitive play, the two-day event will incorporate off-course mentorship workshops connecting I Promise students directly with professional golfers who climbed through the Pro-Bound Five pipeline.

Reflecting on the monumental collaboration, James stated, "This partnership with the PGA Tour gives my foundation a chance to introduce my I Promise students and more people to the game at a young age, support talented athletes chasing their dreams, and continue investing in the city of Akron that means everything to me."

Without a doubt, King James is meticulously building his post-basketball empire, a reality that will undoubtedly feel surreal once his playing days officially conclude, but for now, the future Hall of Famer still has two final seasons left to chase history on the court.

articles.title: Concern about the mental health of former NBA and Real Madrid player Kyle Singler
articles.standfirst: The former player once again posts videos in which he says his life is in danger and attacks Mike Krzyzewski, his former coach at Duke
articles.summary: The former player once again posts videos in which he says his life is in danger and attacks Mike Krzyzewski, his former coach at Duke
articles.body:
Former player Kyle Singler 's mental health is once again a cause for concern after videos were posted on his Instagram account in which he can be seen looking disheveled and lashing out at legendary coach Mike Krzyzewski , who coached him at Duke University . He also claims that people have entered his home, stolen money from him, and tampered with his bank accounts.

In sometimes unintelligible language, Singler can be heard saying that his former coach has "set a trap" for him and "abandoned" him. The small forward, who is 38 years old, was the standout player in the NCAA title that Duke won in 2010 with Coach K on the bench. "Coach, where are you? I thought we were on the same team," he can be heard saying.

The former player claims to feel like a prisoner: "I am locked in my house and I no longer have freedom." His bank accounts, he says, are frozen and they have even cut off the electricity at a home in which he feels "like a prisoner."

'The most worrying part is when Singler confesses: "My life is in danger." It is not the first time he has said it. In November 2024, he had already posted a video in which he claimed to have been mistreated and feared for his life. At that time, the NBA players' union got in touch with his family, and players such as Kevin Love, Isaiah Thomas and Andre Drummond publicly offered him their support. "I love you, Kyle. Message me whenever you want, please," wrote the first of them.'

Singler, a college star, had his first professional experience with Lucentum Alicante . He then signed for Real Madrid , where he spent the 2011-12 season. The Pistons opened the doors to the NBA for him, and he also played for the Thunder . After six seasons in the United States, he returned to Spain to join Obradoiro and play two games with La Laguna in 2019.

articles.summary: The Lakers star’s offseason trip has drawn fresh attention amid breakup with Anamaria Goltes
articles.body:
L uka Doncic brought his Lakers teammates to Slovenia for a few days of golf, sightseeing and time away from basketball. One stop on that trip, however, has generated far more attention than the others.

The Los Angeles Lakers star was reportedly at an exclusive Ljubljana restaurant and nightclub on Friday night, where former Playboy model Anja Jenko was also present. The sighting has fueled interest because Doncic is already dealing with the aftermath of his split from longtime partner Anamaria Goltes .

There is an important distinction: the available reporting does not say Doncic and Jenko arrived together, spent the night as a pair or are dating. It only places them at the same venue.

That has not stopped the curiosity.

Anja Jenko already had a public profile in Slovenia

Jenko is a Slovenian model and social media personality from Ljubljana who became widely known after appearing on the cover of Playboy Magazine in 2014.

She was 34 at the time of the reports and had built an Instagram following of more than 124,000.

Her presence at the event drew notice partly because she is a recognizable figure in Slovenian celebrity circles, while Doncic remains one of the country’s most famous athletes.

articles.standfirst: The Lakers star returned home to Slovenia to visit newborns and children before an unexpected encounter brought his own story full circle
articles.summary: The Lakers star returned home to Slovenia to visit newborns and children before an unexpected encounter brought his own story full circle
articles.body:
The Lakers star returned home to Slovenia to visit newborns and children before an unexpected encounter brought his own story full circle

Luka Doncic walked into a maternity ward in his native Slovenia expecting to surprise new parents. Instead, one mother had a surprise waiting for him: she had just named her newborn baby Luka.

The Los Angeles Lakers star smiled as he met the mother and her tiny son during a special visit to University Medical Center Ljubljana, handing over a Lakers welcome package for the newborn. It was a simple interaction, but one that quickly became one of the sweetest moments of a day dedicated to remembering Kobe Bryant.

Luka Doncic brings Kobe Day home to Slovenia

The visit took place as part of the Lakers' Kobe Day tradition with UCLA Health, celebrated on August 24 in honor of the Nos. 8 and 24 Bryant wore during his legendary career. This year, the initiative traveled to Doncic's home country, where Luka and his Lakers teammates spent time with newborns, young patients and their families.

For the children, however, there was little doubt about who the biggest attraction was. Austin Reaves joked about the reception his teammate received in his own country: "They love Luka more, as they should. Luka is a hero!" For Doncic, it was a chance to return some of that affection to the city where his own story began.

While walking through the hospital, Doncic reunited with Branko Cvjetićanin, the obstetrician who was present when Luka himself was born in Ljubljana more than 27 years ago.

The basketball superstar who had returned home to welcome a new generation of Slovenian babies suddenly found himself face-to-face with someone who had been there at the very beginning of his own life.

On a day created to preserve Kobe Bryant's legacy, the moment carried an unexpectedly personal meaning. Doncic came home to make children smile, met a newborn already carrying his name and ended up reconnecting with the doctor who was there when the original Luka first entered the world.

articles.title: LeBron fever: he still hasn’t been introduced and he has already caused this scene in Philadelphia
articles.standfirst: The arrival of the NBA star has already caused an unexpected scene in the city: Fans are lining up to get his jersey.
articles.summary: The arrival of the NBA star has already caused an unexpected scene in the city: Fans are lining up to get his jersey.
articles.body:
The new star player of Philadelphia has not yet been officially introduced to his team's fans, but some of them are already willing to get his jersey by waiting in front of the official store.

The Sixers store located at the Xfinity Mobile Arena , the team’s home in Philadelphia, opened on two exceptional days to put the new merchandise from the Sixers on sale. The 41-year-old player’s jersey was the main attraction.

The arrival of the star has already caused a phenomenon that goes far beyond the court

It has been just over 30 days since James announced his plans to spend the final stretch of his career in Philadelphia; however, "The King James" has still not appeared before his new fans. According to Fanatics, the basketball legend has already surpassed Shohei Ohtani and has become the player who sold the most jerseys after changing teams. His commercial impact is evident.

Demand also spread to other stores. For example, when LeBron shirts became available to the public at Dick’s Sporting Goods, they sold out quickly, another sign of the anticipation generated by his arrival even before playing a game with the 76ers.

Victoria Isley, vice president of team collaboration solutions, said that the store is normally only open on game days, but understanding the excitement generated by the superstar, the Sixers executives decided to do something special to help fans get ready for the season.

“Fans have been very excited throughout the entire preseason, with the multiple additions,” Isley said. “So I think we’re ready for the season to start, and I think the fans are showing that by lining up early to get their gear and jerseys before the start of the season.”

Among the fans who lined up was also Cam Johnson, a 21-year-old young man from Oak Ridge, New Jersey, who hopes that LeBron's arrival will end with the team celebrating a championship.

“Without a doubt, the excitement is going to continue” , Johnson said . “Whenever you have LeBron James on your team, you’re going to get a lot of attention from the media, from the fans, from everyone. But we have the greatest of all time on our team, in my opinion, two of the best, and I expect to win a championship because this team reached the second round last year.”

“Now they add the best player of all time to this team—and I think he fits perfectly—and now they also have Jaylen Brown. I have high expectations.”

The 2026-27 season has not started yet, and the impact of the Sixers' new number 23 is already evident . Now, the expectation is to see whether the fever that began with the jerseys will also carry over to the team's performance when James finally makes his de but with Philadelphia.

articles.title: Michael Jordan's one-and-done return to the NBA with NBC leaves fans wanting more
articles.standfirst: Jordan's only contribution was a sit-down interview divided into several segments throughout the season
articles.summary: Jordan's only contribution was a sit-down interview divided into several segments throughout the season
articles.body:
Last season when the NBA announced that the NBC would be back broadcasting games thru all season after a 23 year break the "old" fans were amazed because the iconic intros and productions from the 90's were back.

Now their content is distributed across NBC Sports , Peacock , USA Network , and Telemundo and will run up through the 2035–36 season and the whole agreement expands again with the introduction of Sunday Night Basketball , a new series adding even more NBA action to the NBC family.

Michael Jordan's Brief NBC Stint

Of course, the most famous player from the '90s is Michael Jordan , who was supposed to participate a lot last season, but his only contribution was a sit-down interview with Mike Tirico that was split into multiple segments and aired throughout the season, making it seem like a contractual obligation, albeit a very good one.

Now, for the next season, "Your Airness" is not expected to return to NBC Sports ' NBA coverage after serving as a "special on-air contributor" for just one season.

The six-time NBA champion and five-time MVP , whose legendary career points average sits at an unmatched 30.1 PPG , generated massive media hype when his partnership was first revealed back in May 2025.

Supporters expected regular live insights, game analysis, or fresh perspectives on modern superstars from the Hall of Famer . Instead, the entirety of his on-air presence amounted to pre-recorded footage recycled into the "MJ: Insights to Excellence" segments.

As the calendar turns toward the 2026-27 campaign , basketball enthusiasts are left wondering what could have been.

While NBC's massive 11-year media rights deal continues pushing full steam ahead with star analysts like Reggie Miller and Carmelo Anthony , Jordan's fleeting cameo will go down as one of the most overhyped media arrangements in recent memory.

For now, the icon remains as elusive off the court as he ever was, leaving fans hungry for a level of engagement that was ultimately never delivered.

articles.title: Jimmy Butler solves serious family problem and refocuses on the Warriors and his future
articles.standfirst: Butler and ex Kaitlin Nowak living together after child support battle
articles.summary: Butler and ex Kaitlin Nowak living together after child support battle
articles.body:
J immy Butler ’s lengthy legal battle with former girlfriend Kaitlin Nowak has taken an unexpected turn, with new court documents revealing the pair are now living together.

Nowak filed documents Wednesday saying she and the Golden State Warriors forward recently reached a “comprehensive” parenting agreement involving their three children.

She also stated that she and Butler “are living with one another,” while adding that “there are other circumstances which can be presented to the court.”

Dispute stretched back to 2023

Nowak filed a paternity and child support lawsuit in October 2023. Months later, a judgment established Butler as the biological father of their three children.

The pair subsequently agreed to $55,000 per month in child support, while court records showed Butler was also paying another $10,000 per month for childcare. That additional payment later became contentious.

In late 2024, Butler asked the court to reconsider the childcare expense, arguing that a nanny was unnecessary because two of the children were attending school. His filing also alleged that Nowak was “unemployed and refuses to seek employment.”

A settlement could be weeks away

The latest filing suggests their relationship has changed considerably since those disputes.

Nowak is asking the court to keep the case on the docket and says she believes it can be fully resolved within the next 45 to 60 days. The matter had reportedly been dismissed earlier this month.

The documents don't state whether Butler and Nowak have reconciled romantically, and neither has publicly explained their current living arrangement.

What is clear is that a case once defined by arguments over support, childcare and parenting now appears close to a comprehensive resolution.

articles.title: LeBron James viral Drew League video resurfaces showing what happened after cocky opponent tried to provoke him
articles.standfirst: LeBron looked almost too relaxed. Then another player decided to test him
articles.summary: LeBron looked almost too relaxed. Then another player decided to test him
articles.body:
A video from LeBron James' unforgettable 2022 appearance at the Drew League has resurfaced on social media, and years later, the sequence still tells a pretty entertaining story. The clip begins with LeBron calmly controlling the basketball before an opposing player suddenly reaches in and knocks it away, sending it out of bounds. Nothing particularly unusual there. What happens seconds later is what changes the mood.

As the players move back into position, the opponent walks directly past James and appears to brush him chest-to-chest, lingering just enough to make the moment feel like a challenge. LeBron watches him go by and pulls a hilarious face, almost as if he can't quite believe what just happened. Then he nods his head, adjusts the drawstring on his shorts and gets serious.

LeBron James appeared to flip the switch

From there, the resurfaced video becomes essentially a LeBron James highlight reel. He attacks the basket, spins around defenders, powers his way inside, throws down dunks and creates for his teammates. One play follows another, each making that earlier bit of swagger from his opponent look a little less wise.

James really did dominate that afternoon. Playing alongside DeMar DeRozan for the MMV Cheaters on July 16, 2022, LeBron erupted for 42 points, 16 rebounds and four steals in a 104-102 victory over Black Pearl Elite. It was his first Drew League appearance since 2011, and roughly 2,500 people packed into King/Drew Magnet High School to watch him put on the show.

James was 37 at the time, but there was little about his performance that suggested it. His afternoon included one-handed dunks, fadeaways, pull-up threes, a reverse finish off a spin and a thunderous alley-oop off the backboard. Even the NBA later collected the performance among the memorable highlights from his Drew League return.

Maybe the opposing player was simply competing. Perhaps that brief chest-to-chest brush meant nothing more than the usual swagger of a basketball game. But the way the resurfaced video is edited makes the sequence irresistible: LeBron gets challenged, gives him that look and goes to work. Sometimes it’s better not to provoke the King.
